rules.name: Subject endorsement
rules.description: Verified subject endorsement takes precedence; the endorsed coin with the most subject-held supply wins. A lower-supply later endorsement is a conflict.

rules.name: Identity
rules.description: Name and ticker must independently match the canonical source exactly, including typos. A noticeably similar image copied from an earlier alive coin fails.

rules.name: Meme scope
rules.description: A differently named concept derivative is a separate meme and receives no comparative ruling.

rules.name: Chain fit
rules.description: A chain-native meme must use the source home chain. Otherwise chain is not scored.

rules.name: Launchpad and pair
rules.description: The correct meme pair beats the wrong pair. A launchpad port is a vamp unless the source points there.

rules.name: Beneficiary fees
rules.description: Claimable fees to the natural beneficiary rank higher only when the public tie predates the rival's first real buy.

rules.name: Participation snapshot
rules.description: Participation is frozen at the rival's first real buy. No post-rival activity or grace window counts.

rules.name: Precedence
rules.description: Among otherwise equal coins, earliest real participation wins. Deployment time never breaks a tie.
